summary: Retire both private Core copies of each BMC Detect password after execution and expire delivered probe credentials whose request never runs. Correct the BMC discovery plan to describe its implemented API.

guide.reason: The Detect instructions now distinguish no recorded fence profile from a temporary Core credential and explain cleanup after execution or expiry.

api.reason: The client-facing BMC probe request and result shapes are unchanged, but its Controller-to-Core credential handoff now uses the probe-only bmc_probe purpose rather than fence_bmc. The brokered request uses the client's stable request ID so Core can verify the signed handoff's purpose, request and target before contacting the BMC. Core retires the receipt and materialized file after execution and expires abandoned handoffs locally. An older Core that lacks BMC probing already refuses the probe action; Controller must be upgraded before Core as for the staged probe feature.

roadmap.reason: No phase gate or published capability status changes; physical BMC and browser acceptance remain open.

state.reason: No durable pool setting is added. A purpose-bound Core credential receipt and materialized file are private temporary handoff state; both are removed after the probe or swept after ten minutes by Core, including following restart. A fresh Controller recovers no Detect state and obtains any recorded fence profile from the pool master's membership.

verification.method: Both trust-boundary and corrupt-receipt regressions failed before correction. go test -count=1 ./... passed all Go packages; go test -race -count=1 ./internal/agent -run 'TestABMCProbe|TestUndeliveredBMCProbeCredential|TestExpiredBMCProbe|TestClusterSecret' passed; python3 -m unittest tests.test_api_contract passed 74 tests; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check, python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree and the repository privacy test passed; git diff --check and git diff --cached --check were clean.
verification.limits: No physical BMC or live browser walkthrough was run for this credential-lifecycle correction; those acceptance items remain open in the BMC discovery plan.
